{{Top}}
A '''painkiller''', '''pain killer''', or '''pain blocker''' was a form of medicine that reduced a patient's discomfort.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> They were often carried by field [[Medic/Legends|medics]].
